[SWS_CM_12101] ViolationMessage ErroneousServiceHandleViolation
⌈
Dlt-Message
ErroneousServiceHandleViolation
Description
Violation message that is sent in case an erroneous service handle is passed to the Proxy constructor.
String format: "Violation detected in {processIdentifier} at {location}: Erroneous service handle was
passed to the {className} constructor"
MessageId
0x80000ffe
MessageType
Info
DLT_LOG_FATAL
Dlt-Argument
ArgumentDescription
ArgumentType
ArgumentUnit
processIdentifier
Identifier of the process that caused the violation.
uint8 [encoding UTF-8]
NoUnit
location
An implementation-defined identifier of the location
where the violation was detected, for example
{filename}:{linenumber}.
uint8 [encoding UTF-8]
NoUnit
processingMode
processingMode used to try to create the object.
uint8 [encoding UTF-8]
NoUnit
className
Name of the skeleton class that could not be
constructed.
uint8 [encoding UTF-8]
NoUnit
⌋
